runtime_audit.gcc_base_scope: Ubuntu gcc-14-base contains only directories and documentation, not compiler executables; retained runtime inventory is compared separately.

format.scope: Executed after source freeze; all source inputs rechecked by final evidence assembly

development_findings.detail: Review before final qualification found implicit moves could empty a source cursor prefix while leaving its revision/position. Explicit copy-only cursor semantics preserve source and destination options on rvalue use; dedicated regression passes in every profile.

limits: Trusted local C++ inspection, not authenticated gameplay discovery or an authoring protocol.
Schema version1 is independent of future file/wire/database versions. No persistence, transactions, editor/CLI/Lua adapter or network protocol is delivered by07c.
Continuation is process-local, binds one scene incarnation/revision, and is invalidated by any committed change. No durable ordering or historical full-scene snapshot.
Each call scans at most4096 slots and returns at most256 rows; budget-limited empty pages may still have continuation. All-false field selection returns identities only.
Names contain at most256 UTF-8 bytes. Queries return child counts instead of unbounded child vectors.
World matrices remain scene-local; global cells, origin services and distributed handoff retain their separate ownership.
No new graphics, physics, networking, live MMO capacity or external-machine qualification. FeatureWorld connects in10.
Windows development tools remain installed. WSL shares the kernel and uses retained writable SDK-free runtime userspace with isolated network.
Storage/query bounds are not throughput or latency claims; general allocation-exhaustion recovery is not guaranteed.
